title: How to get help in Windows - Microsoft Support
body: Here are a few different ways to find help for Windows Search for help - Enter a question or keywords in the search box on the taskbar to find apps, files, settings, and get help from the web.

title: About Get Help - Microsoft Support
body: The Windows Get Help app is a centralized hub for accessing a wide range of resources, including tutorials, FAQs, community forums, and direct assistance from Microsoft support personnel.
